body:
Fixes #14856

### Description

When `gh issue develop` is run with `--base` from outside a git repository, the branch is successfully created on GitHub, but the command fails with `failed to run git: fatal: not in a git directory` and exits before printing the branch URL.

This happened because `developRunCreate` invoked `opts.GitClient.SetBranchConfig` to record `branch.<name>.gh-merge-base` before printing the created branch URL and calling `checkoutBranch`. Running `git config` outside a git repository returns an error, halting execution before outputting the URL.

This change moves `SetBranchConfig` into `checkoutBranch`, running git configuration only when local branch checkout operations take place.

### How did you test this change?

Not tested. The full test suite was not run locally, so I am relying on CI to confirm.

### Key points

- Moving `SetBranchConfig` into `checkoutBranch` ensures local git configuration is only attempted when local checkout steps are executed. This allows `gh issue develop` executed outside of a repository to successfully display the branch URL and exit without error.

### Notes for reviewers

Review should start in `pkg/cmd/issue/develop/develop.go`. This modifies the merge base configuration logic introduced in #9712.
